Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, but Norway documents a complete arc of opening and closure, which makes it the most instructive case in this series for this indicator. The Norwegian Puppet Theatre Academy was founded in Fredrikstad in 1991 as a three-year pilot, then organised from 1996 as higher arts education in figure theatre under Ostfold University College. It was recast in 2003 as the Academy of Performing Arts, with figure theatre read more broadly towards performance and visual dramaturgies. Since 2018 the Academy no longer offers figure theatre as a discipline of its own. No training satisfying the denominator therefore remains. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1. Estimate: this chronology comes from search summaries and an encyclopaedic entry, without curricula read at source.
